gloss_en: Esther — the biblical queen of the Purim narrative (heroine of Megillat Esther), invoked as a symbolic figure (bechina) whose name evokes divine concealment (hester/'hastir astir') and who represents Malkhut/Shekhinah, faith, and the feminine partner to Mordekhai; not any other word from the root ס-ת-ר
